description: A competitive eater challenges himself to eat slices of cheesecake and caramel cake. Each slice of cheesecake contains 200 calories and 40 grams of sugar. Each slice of caramel cake contains 250 calories and 50 grams of sugar. He prefers cheesecake and decides to eat at least 3 times as many slices of cheesecake as caramel cake. However, he must also eat at least 3 slices of caramel cake. If he can consume at most 10000 calories in one day, how many slices of each cake should he eat to maximize the total amount of sugar he consumes?

CaloriesCaramelCake.definition: Calories per slice of caramel cake

SugarCaramelCake.definition: Sugar per slice of caramel cake

MinCheesecakeToCaramelRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of cheesecake slices to caramel cake slices

MinCaramelSlices.definition: Minimum number of caramel cake slices

MaxTotalCalories.definition: Maximum total calories that can be consumed in one day

objective.description: "Maximize the total amount of sugar consumed from cheesecake and caramel cake slices"

constraints.description: 200 * (number of cheesecake slices) + 250 * (number of caramel cake slices) <= 10000
Number of cheesecake slices >= 3 * (number of caramel cake slices)

numCaramelSlices.definition: Number of caramel cake slices consumed
